items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: I never did know what his first was -- we used to call him 'Bruz' and his last name was Freeman... [INTERVIEWER] Chico. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah.

ctx.x: Anyway, Sarah got him to work with the group, and a drummer who really came from a musical family. I never did know what his first was -- we used to call him "Bruz" and his last name was Freeman. Bruz Freeman. Bruz had a brother that played guitar [GEORGE FREEMAN] and his other brother plays tenor saxophone [VON FREEMAN], and I think now one of his sons is quite a tenor player...
